raised: The note that the drawings are live and the years can be dragged meant nothing to them, since they were only looking at pictures
The left card (+1,721 ₪, then 394 ₪ less after 5 years) was confusing, and they couldn't see why it was shown
The grey small print about assumptions was only half understood; the rest was names and codes
They gave up counting the coins in the coin towers
The '+527 ₪' step (same money moves to the fund) was confusing, especially since the fund's fees are higher
In the coin towers they couldn't tell whether the striped tax coins are included in the 66,513 ₪ or taken out of it
The fund names and ID codes (S&P500 13245, 5139282, 4D, Fair Financial) meant nothing to them
'Up to the legal ceiling' doesn't say what the ceiling is in shekels
The '19 tracks' range left them unsure whether they have to pick a track, and which one
They weren't sure about the salaried / self-employed switch and just assumed 'salaried'
Missing: what happens if they need the money before 6 years
Missing: what happens if they leave the job or retire early (does the 6-year clock keep running?)
Missing: what happens if the market falls instead of rising 7%
Missing: whether their age changes anything
Missing: how to check whether their employer offers this at all
Would drop the coin towers and the 'same drawing one year later' repeat
Would drop the small print with fund codes, the coloured legend line and the drag hints
Would drop option ב (steps) because option ג shows the same thing

problems.why: The reader gave up counting the coins but praised the table under the graph as excellent, and never complained that the numbers should be written on the graph instead of being read from a separate table.
